title.narrative: Pathways to profitable dairy farming: a public-private development partnership project

description.narrative: The project aims to increase the income of Kenyan dairy farmers by strengthening youth and women#s roles in dairy farming and developing skills within the dairy industry value chain. The approach includes a Public-Private-Development Partnership (PPDP) between UNIDO and Tetra Pak, establishing a dairy academy and model farm to provide comprehensive training programs. These programs will focus on enhancing the dairy production skills of farmers, extension officers, and other industry actors, improving animal health and compliance with milk quality standards, and expanding financial access, particularly for young farmers. Infrastructure development, such as upgrading milk collection centers and optimizing milk collection processes, will also support the long-term sustainability of the dairy industry#. The project will be implemented jointly by SEF and FSS units.
